defects.defect: Rhythm of vertical gaps is uneven — top bar→title ≈35px, title→scene ≈15px, scene→map ≈20px, map→Play ≈30px, Play→nav ≈95px, so the Play button floats in a large dead zone above the nav
defects.direction: Equalize the inter-section margins; tighten the Play→nav gap or center the stack so spacing steps are consistent
defects.region: gap between Play button (y≈1250) and bottom nav bar (y≈1340)

defects.defect: Map content is sparse and lopsided: a vertical chain of node 1 plus two locks runs down the center while decorative props (rocks, skull, campfire / tent, plant, cactus) sit in two isolated side columns, leaving the mid-left and mid-right wood areas empty and unfinished-looking
defects.direction: Distribute the path nodes across the panel with a winding route and spread props around it so no large empty wood regions remain
defects.region: level map panel, y≈750-1140

defects.defect: Energy chip mixes two type sizes ('9/10' large, '50s' small) unlike the single-size sibling chips, and is much wider than the other three chips
